changelog: **Post-meeting feedback — one tap, two questions** (#1896; docs/surveys.md § Meeting feedback). New tenant model `MeetingFeedback` (`@@unique([meetingId, raterId])`, `relationId` denormalised) and nullable `Meeting.feedbackAskedAt`. Ending a meeting in the dashboard banner shows `MeetingFeedbackCard` (did it take place? how helpful, 1–5? optional note) → `POST /api/meetings/[id]/feedback`. When nobody ended it, the auto-log sweep now returns `loggedIds` and `askForMeetingFeedback()` mails the mentee once — the meeting row is claimed before sending, a second sweep asks nobody, guests are never asked — with six signed one-click links (`src/lib/meetingFeedbackToken.ts`, own HMAC domain) to `/meeting-feedback/<token>`, which records from the browser (`GET /api/meeting-feedback/[token]` only reads; mail scanners prefetch). "We didn't meet" is stored as `happened = false` and never scored. A mentor reads only `GET /api/mentor/meeting-feedback`: the aggregate of other people's answers above the response floor (`surveyPrivacy.effectiveMinResponses`), never a rating, rater or note; `meetingQualityFor(relationId, windowDays)` returns null under the floor for the health score. Mail category `meeting-feedback` in the task-reminders group. Free — no entitlement check.

en: After a meeting you can now say in one tap whether it happened and how helpful it was — in the app right after ending it, or from a single e-mail without logging in. The other person only ever sees an average of several answers.
tr: Bir toplantıdan sonra artık tek dokunuşla toplantının gerçekleşip gerçekleşmediğini ve ne kadar faydalı olduğunu söyleyebilirsin — bitirdikten hemen sonra uygulamada ya da giriş yapmadan tek bir e-postadan. Karşı taraf yalnızca birkaç cevabın ortalamasını görür.
de: Nach einem Termin kannst du jetzt mit einem Tipp angeben, ob er stattgefunden hat und wie hilfreich er war — direkt nach dem Beenden in der App oder ohne Anmeldung aus einer einzigen E-Mail. Die andere Person sieht immer nur einen Durchschnitt aus mehreren Antworten.
